lines.zh: 我在水里翻了个身，滚动起来
lines.en: I tumble and roll through the water.
The current carries me a stretch.
I roll slowly along the bottom.
I drift and turn at the same time.
My body has curled into a ball.
I squeeze between the stones.
Water pushes, and I follow.
I roll over a patch of weeds.
My shell gleams underwater.

lines.zh: 我沉下去一点，又浮起来
lines.en: I sink a little, then rise.
I spiral down deeper.
When the current eases, I stop.
I bump softly against a log.
I roll right past a fish.
My rolling is nearly silent.
I drift right back to where I was.
I float, perfectly still.
Water slides over my shell.
I look like a round stone.
I wait for the water to move me.
I curl myself up very tight.

lines.zh: 水底的泥慢慢落在我身上
lines.en: Silt settles slowly on me.
I do nothing at all.
Fine lines run across my shell.
Light comes down thin through the water.
I am safe here.
A weed has caught on me.
I turn half a circle and stop.
Nothing else is around.
I rest in the shadow.
You look at me through the water.
I rise a little to see you.
I am round as a pebble.
Why are you reaching in?
My shell is harder than you think.

lines.zh: 我不动，你也就看不清我
lines.en: If I stay still, you cannot tell what I am.
You on the bank, me in the water.
I rotate slowly.
What are you looking for in the water?
I have no intention of coming ashore.
The blow makes me curl tighter.
A mark appears on my shell.
The blow rolls me twice.
I sink to the bottom to hide.
That one hurt.
My shell has a small crack.
I am pushed off my spot.

lines.zh: 被打散的水纹慢慢合拢了。
lines.en: The ripples I scattered slowly close back up.
I can still roll, no problem.
The water took most of it.
I try whatever is in the water.

lines.zh: 你扔的东西沉底了，我够不着。
lines.en: What you dropped has sunk to the bottom, out of my reach.
I roll over to look.
Put it in the water and I am interested.
I do not eat dry things.
It looks rounder than I am.
I bump into it.
That is not enough.
I fold it into my body.
You are luring me, and I know it.
You bumped me, and I rolled away.
We are both round.
I bounce off a little.
Do not push, I do not stop easily.
I bump against the bank.
Not even a splash.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子滚过去
lines.en: I have rolled to your feet.
That was a very light touch.
I roll between your legs.
And I roll right back.
We rolled into each other.
Two balls, stacked.
Water matters stay in the water.
I cannot tell which one is which.
We are merely close.
There is nothing to say about that.
We turn half a circle together.
Two round shadows on the bottom.
The two of us do not come apart.
We stay like this together.
What sinks is mine.
I roll it into myself.
It is stuck in my shell seam.
I roll along pushing it.
This has no taste.
I swallow slower than usual.
It is much smaller than me.
I drift along with it.
Whoever dropped it, I keep it.
I press it down to the bed.
I am rolling toward you.

lines.zh: 在水里，我的圆身一转就没影。
lines.en: In the water, one spin of my round body and I am gone.
I have picked you out.
I have rolled to your feet.
I tighten up to strike.
You are backing into the shallows.
My shadow is on the bottom.
I make no sound, only roll.
Wherever you go, I follow.
You will not dodge this.
I roll slowly to your flank.
Those rings on the water are me.
I have been at your feet all along.
You may not look, but I am here.
My shell grows warm as I roll.
I wait for the water to shallow.
You stepped into the water.

lines.zh: 我浮在水里，数着你踏水的节拍。
lines.en: I float and count the rhythm of your splashing steps.
Each roll brings me closer.
This time I will not drift away.
I slam into your ankle.

lines.zh: 我全身的重量都在这一下
lines.en: All my weight went into that.
You stumble.
I hit and roll to the side.
The ridges of my shell scrape you.

lines.zh: 这一撞不重，来得却突然
lines.en: Not a hard hit, but a sudden one.

lines.zh: 我从你背后弹回来，撞你腰。
lines.en: I bounce back from behind and ram your waist.
Now there is a splash.

lines.zh: 你低头看的时候我已经走了
lines.en: By the time you look down, I am gone.
Round does not mean harmless.
I rise from the bottom.
A round shadow joins the water.
I rolled into these waters.
I like this current.
I slowly unfurl.
I found a spot on the bottom.
There is nothing else in this water.
I drifted a long way to get here.

lines.zh: 我的壳上还带着别处的水草
lines.en: Weeds from elsewhere still cling to me.
This water is quiet enough.
The water heats and my shell burns.
I am flung onto the rocks.
The water is too deep for me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀了出去
lines.en: The blast throws me up out of the water.
An arrow cracks against my shell.

lines.zh: 魔法穿过水，打在我身上
lines.en: Magic cuts through the water into me.
Nothing edible in this water.
Lightning finds me across the water.
The water vanishes.
